description: This Java interface extends Spring Data JPA repositories for the CommandSource entity, providing custom query methods for accessing command source data, including a method for deleting old events based on status and date criteria.

classes.name: CommandSourceRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for CommandSource entities, providing CRUD and custom query operations.

methods.name: findByActionNameAndEntityNameAndIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Finds a CommandSource entity matching the specified action name, entity name, and idempotency key.

methods.name: deleteOlderEventsWithStatus
methods.description: Deletes CommandSource records with a specific status and a madeOnDate earlier than or equal to the specified date.

calls: delete from CommandSource c where c.status = :status and c.madeOnDate is not null and c.madeOnDate <= :dateForPurgeCriteria
